Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

what kept you? phrase

also what took you so long?, where have you been?, why are you late?, what held you up?

modern

Traupman 101: quid tenuit quō minus venīrēs?
Traupman 336

Quid tenuit quōminus venīrēs?

quōminus with the subjunctive after a verb of hindering

what kept you from coming?

The construction (tenēre quōminus) is classical; the question as such is Traupman’s. Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

Other words

  • Quid tē remorātum est? — what held you up?

    also used · Renaissance · Erasm. Coll., Fōrm., In culpā, in causā, in morā, I 68

Examples

  • Tū nōbīs in morā fuistī. Tū semper in morā es. Quid tē remorātum est?

    You held us up; you’re always the one we wait for; what kept you?Erasm. Coll., Fōrm., In culpā, in causā, in morā, I 68

  • Quid tē impedīvit?

    What held you up?Traupman 328

See also keep someone waiting, am I keeping you?.
